svg.title: How a call reaches a server
svg.desc: 1: The MCP client sends a tool call with its access token. 2: Dagu Console checks the four limits. 3: Dagu Console signs the call for one request and one server, valid for at most a minute. 4: The relay forwards it over the WebSocket the server opened. 5: The server verifies the signature and that the call is new. 6: The server applies its own level and runs the tool. 7: The server writes its audit log. 8: The answer returns the same way, and Dagu Cloud does not store it.
